notes.title: Major Demo Update: New Escape & Block Mechanics Are Here!
notes.content:
Hey champ!
A major update has just dropped for the Boxing Machine VR demo — and it’s all thanks to you! 🥊


During and since Steam Next Fest, we’ve received tons of amazing feedback from players. This update brings some of the most requested improvements to the Rhythm Mode:

🎮 Reworked Escape & Block Mechanics:
Say goodbye to screen cues — now you’ll read the fight directly from the robot’s moves:

When the glove turns spiked, it means escape!

When it’s wrapped in rope, get ready to block!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594341/af9a709fbce84418f74ec9a0a58aedd122736b58.png"]

⚙️ New Animations:
Stronger feedback, more fluid motions — every action now looks and feels better than ever.

💥 Eye-Pop Feature:
Land rapid punches and watch the robot’s eyes pop out! A small detail with big personality.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594341/f65315bb53523909cf17befa1a5c19b5a517a037.png"]

📽️ New Trailer is Live!
We’ve also released a brand new trailer featuring all the robots you’ll face in the full game. Don’t miss it!

We're incredibly grateful for your support and feedback — keep it coming!



🗓️ Boxing Machine VR launches on August 29 — wishlist now and get ready to step into the ring!
